tools.name: StemLab
tools.task: Analyse selected audio/MIDI evidence or edit supported timing lanes
inputs: Master hash, source rate and canonical words
Saved analysis, selected detectors and explicit model choice
outputs: Source-bound analysis, timing proposals and uniquely named derivatives
acceptance: Compare original and offset beat grids, including half/double-time hypotheses
Hash original inputs before/after; review estimated lyrics and MIDI
limits: Detector confidence is not artist-approved BPM or transcription
A timeline control and its editor/gallery applications need their own package/runtime checks

tools.name: DanceRudiments
tools.task: Select native movement or prepare a finite, typed rig recording
inputs: Integer 64-pip source clock, rig profile and provenance
Reviewed target character and motion/calibration data
outputs: Native pattern selection or bounded recording with explicit retarget mapping
acceptance: Verify the requested target mesh and bind/profile hashes
Check start/end/seek, units and loop seams only where a loop is claimed
limits: Preview speed is not verified musical beat matching
Rig-tempo confidence and lyric-match thresholds are separate measures

tools.name: FrameRudiments
tools.task: Compose a deterministic offline video or bounded preset experiment
inputs: Pinned audio, timing, artwork/font hashes and source offsets
Native movement and reviewed renderer/preset parameters
outputs: New encoded video, timing/frame ledger and optional response evidence
acceptance: Decode actual final bytes; inspect first frames, captions, crop, loop and soundtrack mapping
For feedback, replay preceding frames and compare programme/silence/probe conditions
limits: A controlled response or cached still does not prove musical quality
Do not rerun a full catalogue or analysis merely for documentation

tools.name: DanceMoves
tools.task: Attach live web effects to a verified playback/input owner
inputs: Page-owned appearance and metadata-derived timing
Exact source/offset association and selected runtime
outputs: Bounded shared clock/controllers connected to painted consumers
acceptance: Exercise play/pause/seek/end, switches and reset/teardown
Verify actual pixels and pointer/phone routes; preserve full-page appearance
limits: A listener or loaded library is not a connected visual effect
Synthetic sensors and software rendering are not physical-device acceptance

tools.name: KeywordMoves
tools.task: Research and reconcile source-specific keyword observations
inputs: Canonical phrase register, exact source/window and reviewed exports
Explicit local/hosted model selection only when needed
outputs: Deduplicated phrases, attributed observations and separate hypotheses
acceptance: Re-import changed records and verify schema/deduplication
Keep literal text, demand, platform metric and inference distinct
limits: An extraction score is not measured audience demand
A source import or roadmap does not imply a native live provider

tools.name: RasterMoves
tools.task: Prepare a reviewed upscale or bounded refinement comparison
inputs: Authorised source image, target dimensions and alpha/crop policy
Selected plugin/model revision under project-local models/
outputs: New image candidates and runtime/model settings
acceptance: Inspect actual delivered dimensions, alpha, edges and crop
Compare target-size candidates against the original
limits: A model catalogue entry is not an installed or useful model
No blanket model downloads or original-image overwrite

tools.name: LikenessForge
tools.task: Repair likeness or train/use a specifically authorised identity profile
inputs: Authorised reference identity and source composition
Pinned compatible model/LoRA, seed and bounded settings
outputs: Private comparison candidates and reproducible profile evidence
acceptance: Review likeness, blend and complete composition at delivery size
Verify actual optional dependencies and one relevant inference
limits: Installed core CLI is not qualified face processing or training
A successful inference does not establish likeness approval or public-use rights

tools.name: PixelCue
tools.task: Measure visual assets or serve a bounded local analysis request
inputs: Exact media bytes and requested measurements
Explicit optional model profile and actual service/runtime identity
outputs: Statistics, selected model observations and request-scoped receipts
acceptance: Verify health and the actual analysis route; retain unavailable model states
Preserve deterministic measurements independently of semantic hypotheses
limits: Do not duplicate its analysis engine in callers
A loaded model/service is not evidence of a completed request

tools.name: PrismMoves
tools.task: Synthesize an image profile or temporal-first preset description
inputs: PixelCue measurements and condition/frame lineage
Time intervals, programme/silence/probes and selected semantic evidence
outputs: Evidence-labelled profile, response families and retained comparisons
acceptance: Inspect chronological condition sheets and isolated selected outputs
Use content-addressed output identity; retain history before revised reports
limits: Similar frames do not become independent evidence
A model interpretation is not a measured identity or one universal quality score

tools.name: ThumbMoves
tools.task: Request a thumbnail already present in the operating-system cache
inputs: Selected local file, cache backend and requested format/size
outputs: Cache-hit thumbnail or explicit miss/backend result
acceptance: Verify actual cache evidence and bounded failures
Return miss honestly where no public backend exists
limits: A cache miss is not permission to decode the source
Do not infer macOS cache support from another platform

tools.name: React Timeline Sequence
tools.task: Build a selected-source audio/timing editor or inspection timeline
inputs: Stable asset identity, source rate and controlled transport
Beat, line/word/cue or MIDI lanes with explicit coordinate units
outputs: Callbacks, sample-frame loop/seek edits and source-bound audition
acceptance: Verify controlled callback persistence, seek/loop bounds and selected-source lyrics
Confirm package consumers and asset changes reset the correct owner
limits: A reusable control is distinct from its editor application
Do not let view coordinates or a second clock alter original source time

tools.name: EPK Social Metadata
tools.task: Stage canonical Open Graph, X and Schema.org music/page facts
inputs: Fresh canonical release/page/audio facts and eligible public media
outputs: Reviewed minimal metadata fields and anonymous source evidence
acceptance: Read back exact persisted values and public rendered tags
Preserve WordPress ownership of title/canonical/robots/sitemap
limits: Correct markup does not prove social-card display or ranking
Public saves retain their exact approval and source gates

tools.name: WorkflowMoves
tools.task: Propagate reviewed shared lessons without replacing project instructions
inputs: Exact maintained route manifest and fresh target bytes
Public-safe lesson verified against source and execution evidence
outputs: Preview/apply/repeat receipts and matching released workflow package
acceptance: Require known managed block identity and unchanged surrounding bytes
Check full ecosystem workflow coverage, then run owning release tests
limits: Installed guidance does not prove adoption by another running chat
Private chat transcripts and scheduler definitions stay outside releases

tools.name: DanceVault
tools.task: Prepare authorised encrypted delivery on a qualified destination host
inputs: Exact approved source bytes, recipient/expiry policy and private credentials
outputs: Encrypted container, independent source/container hashes and delivery evidence
acceptance: Verify the exact Apache/nginx/WordPress host route and actual access behaviour
Exercise expiry/revocation and fail-closed error paths within authorised scope
limits: Test-host acceptance is not destination-host deployment acceptance
No plaintext fallback, sensitive upload or access-policy expansion

tools.name: MediaSlide
tools.task: Compose a media browser with stable selection and explicit pagination
inputs: Stable item IDs, bounded fixtures and an explicitly sized host
Controlled mode/selection/page state and real pagination callbacks
outputs: List/details/thumbnails/slide rendering with retained request evidence
acceptance: Exercise all four modes, selection, custom rendering and Previous/Next
Record observer requests without autonomous fixture page changes
limits: A deterministic harness must still observe the real callback
Tagged package, main demo, WordPress ZIP and deployed site are distinct

tools.name: Potbot
tools.task: Use durable native coding tasks/jobs on a qualified host
inputs: Registered workspace/sandbox, exact repository/candidate and task contract
Qualified provider/model, budget and effect authority
outputs: Durable jobs, retained candidate artifacts and verification/usage receipts
acceptance: Verify actual host isolation, workspace containment and interrupted-run reconciliation
Keep private custody qualification separate from published verification-key checks
limits: Source preview; registered models and planned MCP routes are not implementation
No unrestricted execution fallback or automatic host/account changes

tools.name: DanceFlow for Unity
tools.task: Import the reviewed UPM package and run a source-bound clock/rig sample
inputs: Exact Unity/package identity, approved sample, master clock and rig profile
Qualified target mesh/GPU and independent finite recording clock
outputs: Native Editor/Player sample evidence with exact source and consumer identities
acceptance: Test the actual package import and requested visible character/materials
Verify play/pause/seek, finite bounds and source mapping in the native host
limits: Managed tests or a subset-copy CI consumer do not qualify whole-root UPM import
Deployed WebGL and software rendering do not prove physical GPU or musical alignment

tools.name: DanceFlow toolkit
tools.task: Discover useful components and compose their supported contracts
inputs: Current catalogue, exact releases and observed runtime/host identities
outputs: Purpose-specific plan, typed discovery/adapters and explicit availability states
acceptance: Run the no-service discovery example and check the actual invoked adapter
Keep seventeen member engines separate from the discovery/composition toolkit
limits: Discovery is not execution or native-host qualification
Short Shifter remains independent; no blanket model or service setup
